map.气压估海拔准吗？: Is estimating altitude from pressure accurate?
map.受天气系统、温度、湿度影响明显。同一海拔上高低压天气可使读数偏差数百米，需结合温: It is markedly affected by weather systems, temperature and humidity. At the same altitude, high and low pressure weather can shift the reading by several hundred metres, so a temperature correction or a measured sea-level pressure is needed.
map.为什么高海拔气压明显降低？: Why does pressure drop noticeably at high altitude?
map.大气重量随高度递减，约每升高 5500 m 气压减半；随海拔高度增加，空气柱变短: The weight of the atmosphere decreases with height, roughly halving for every 5500 m of ascent; as altitude increases the air column becomes shorter and the density falls, so the reading drops accordingly.
